pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. Spatial area of patches varies from medium-sized units on the flank to smaller, more elongated units on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored pathways forming trivalent junction nodes. Corridor thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-section with occasional thinning at nodal intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the dorsal line of the neck and shoulder, appearing as a short-bristled fringe against the sky and background.
